name: RITA

name: MyKey

name: C2AI
project: Command and Control Agentic AI System

name: Benefit Scout

name: Ask 3M
use: AI digital assistant that helps engineers find 3M adhesives and tapes and technical information for their design problems.

name: ReefGPT
use: EA's internal AI chatbot for developers, used for coding and other work. It has been reported as error-prone.

name: StarIQ
